Property.name: Mode
Property.doc: - Standard: wires, shells, compsolids remain in one piece. - Split: wires, shells, compsolids are split. - CompSolid: make compsolid from solid fragments.

Property.name: Tolerance
Property.doc: Tolerance when intersecting (fuzzy value). In addition to tolerances of the shapes.

Item.value: Standard steel material for CalculiX sample calculations
Standard distilled water properties at 20 Degrees Celsius and 1 atm

Property.name: ElementDimension
Property.doc: Dimension of mesh elements (Auto = according ShapeType of part to mesh)

Property.name: GroupsOfNodes
Property.doc: For each group create not only the elements but the nodes too.

Property.name: MeshSizeFromCurvature
Property.doc: number of elements per 2*pi radians, 0 to deactivate

Property.name: OptimizeNetgen
Property.doc: Optimize tetra elements by use of Netgen

Property.name: Part
Property.doc: Geometry object, the mesh is made from. The geometry object has to have a Shape.

Property.name: Recombine3DAll
Property.doc: Apply recombination algorithm to all volumes

Property.name: RecombineAll
Property.doc: Apply recombination algorithm to all surfaces

Property.name: SecondOrderLinear
Property.doc: Second order nodes are created by linear interpolation

Property.name: CharacteristicLength
Property.doc: set characteristic length of FEM elements for this region

Property.name: References
Property.doc: List of FEM mesh region shapes

Property.name: OutputIntervals
Property.doc: After how many time steps a result file is output

Property.name: TimestepIntervals
Property.doc: List of maximum optimization rounds if 'Simulation Type' is either 'Scanning' or 'Transient'

Property.name: TimestepSizes
Property.doc: List of time steps of optimization if 'Simulation Type' is either 'Scanning' or 'Transient'

Property.name: Convection
Property.doc: Type of convection to be used

Property.name: DivDiscretization
Property.doc: Set to true for incompressible flow for more stable discretization when Reynolds number increases

Property.name: GradpDiscretization
Property.doc: If true pressure Dirichlet boundary conditions can be used. Also mass flux is available as a natural boundary condition.

Property.name: LinearSystemSolverDisabled
Property.doc: Disable the linear system. Only use for special cases and consult the Elmer docs.

Property.name: MagneticInduction
Property.doc: Magnetic induction equation will be solved along with the Navier-Stokes equations

Property.name: Priority
Property.doc: Number of your choice The equation with lowest number will be solved first.

Property.name: RelaxationFactor
Property.doc: Value below 1.0 might be necessary to achieve convergence Typical values are in the range [0.3, 1.0]

Property.name: Variable
Property.doc: Only for a 2D model change the '3' to '2'

Property.name: Convection
Property.doc: Type of convection to be used

Property.name: LinearSystemSolverDisabled
Property.doc: Disable the linear system. Only use for special cases and consult the Elmer docs.

Property.doc: Number of your choice The equation with lowest number will be solved first.

Property.name: RelaxationFactor
